card.name: Capital-, Cap- and Kaplan word parts
card.fires_on: Fires on the later part of words beginning with Cap or Kap, such as Capitalize, capitalization and Capella, and on Kaplan in Kaplan-Meier. It is strongest in style-guide talk about capitalizing.
